verdict.rationale: Orama documents its own bulk-insert API, `insertMultiple`, with a configurable batch size (default 1000), recommended for large record sets because it avoids blocking the event loop. However, nothing shows async task tracking or indexing-completion status, and there is no evidence of throughput at million-document scale. Missing for 10: async task/job tracking to know when indexing completes, evidence of import speed at millions of documents, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can bulk-import millions of documents quickly, with async task tracking to know when indexing completes

citations.quote: You can pass a third, optional, parameter to change the batch size (default: 1000).
Inserting a large number of documents in a loop could potentially block the event loop. Instead `insertMultiple` handles this case better.
If you have a lot of records, we suggest using the `insertMultiple` function
